sources.title: NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures
William Pugh — A Skip List Cookbook

corrections: Qualified linked-list O(1) updates as requiring an already-known position; traversal remains O(n).
Qualified slice-backed stack and queue appends as amortized O(1).
Separated heap peek O(1) from delete-top O(log n).
Made hash-table average O(1) conditional on hash distribution and load factor.
Corrected skip-list bounds to expected O(log n) operations and expected O(n) space, with O(n) worst-case search.
Replaced the ambiguous Trie O(26n) space claim with representation-dependent space semantics.
